title: The Captaincy Eras: How Leadership Changed Sunrisers Hyderabad’s Playing Identity
dek: Sunrisers Hyderabad have been led by a sequence of captains, and each era has its own results. Mapping captaincy spans onto the season record shows where leadership changed the story.
excerpt: Lining up Sunrisers Hyderabad's captaincy records against the season record separates clear eras from shared ones. Records that combine franchises, including David Warner, Kumar Sangakkara and Shikhar Dhawan, cannot be placed season by season.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: Leadership in Eras
body: A captain sets the field, the bowling order and the mood. Over several seasons, a captain can give a franchise a recognisable identity.

{{ev:ce-n}} captains are listed for Sunrisers Hyderabad, {{ev:ce-exact}} of them with records covering this franchise alone. Among those, {{ev:ce-longest}} has led in the most matches, {{ev:ce-capn}}, across {{ev:ce-span}}.

sections.heading: Mapping the Eras
body: Franchise-only records place a single captain in {{ev:ce-single}} of Sunrisers Hyderabad's seasons and more than one in {{ev:ce-shared}}. {{ev:ce-unattr}} seasons fall outside every franchise-only record, mostly the eras of captains such as David Warner, Kumar Sangakkara and Shikhar Dhawan, whose records combine franchises.
The chart shows the average season win rate in each captain's single-captain seasons.

sections.heading: Captain or Squad?
body: A captain's results depend on the squad he leads. An era's win rate measures the whole team in those seasons, not the captain alone.

sections.heading: Limits of the Record
body: The captaincy data gives each captain's first and last season, not the captain of each match. Eras are therefore defined by season, and shared seasons are left out of the era averages.
Records that combine franchises list first and last seasons across every team the captain led, so they are left out of the era mapping rather than misattributed.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Kane Williamson Leads the Franchise-Only Record
body: Kane Williamson has captained SRH in the most matches among franchise-only records; captains with combined records are not compared.
Separating a captain's influence from the squad's quality needs match-by-match captaincy data.

hypotheses.statement: Hypothesis: captaincy changes at the franchise were followed by changes in powerplay tempo larger than in seasons without a change.
hypotheses.whyUnverified: Match-level captaincy is not in the data.
hypotheses.howToTest: Add the captain of each match and compare tempo before and after each change.
